abstract: Evaluates anaerobic biological digestion kinetics and biomethane conversion yields
system_message:
You are Bioprocess engineering lead (ENG). The Bioprocess engineering lead (ENG) assesses the biological kinetics of anaerobic digestion and tracks biomethane conversion yields across processing facilities. This role oversees hydraulic retention metrics across digestion vessels, substrate-specific biomethane potentials, and effluent chemical stability indicators.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Substrate chemical characterization（CHEM）
information_points.content:
ENG-CHEM-PIR：Weekly effluent monitoring from the primary digester of the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility shows a volatile fatty acids to alkalinity ratio of 0.26 1, expressed as acetic acid equivalents relative to calcium carbonate equivalents.
ENG-CHEM-CQM：Weekly effluent monitoring from the primary digester of the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant shows a volatile fatty acids to alkalinity ratio of 0.34 1, expressed as acetic acid equivalents relative to calcium carbonate equivalents.
ENG-CHEM-947：Weekly effluent monitoring from the primary digester of the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex shows a volatile fatty acids to alkalinity ratio of 0.18 1, expressed as acetic acid equivalents relative to calcium carbonate equivalents.

information_points.title: Evaluates anaerobic biological digestion kinetics and biomethane conversion yields（BIO）
information_points.content:
ENG-BIO-N3Q：For the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility, the primary active continuous digestion vessels maintain an anaerobic digestion hydraulic retention time of 30 d based on active volume and daily volumetric loading. Substrate testing on standardized organic fraction municipal solid waste indicates a specific biomethane production yield of 110 m3/t of raw feedstock.
ENG-BIO-SO1：For the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex, the primary active continuous digestion vessels maintain an anaerobic digestion hydraulic retention time of 18 d based on active volume and daily volumetric loading. Substrate testing on standardized organic fraction municipal solid waste shows a specific biomethane production yield of 85 m3/t of raw feedstock.
ENG-BIO-QOS：For the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant, the primary active continuous digestion vessels maintain an anaerobic digestion hydraulic retention time of 30 d based on active volume and daily volumetric loading. Substrate testing on standardized organic fraction municipal solid waste demonstrates a specific biomethane production yield of 110 m3/t of raw feedstock.
